stories.title: Flintshire schools are mark Odd Socks Day as Anti-Bullying Week begins
stories.summary: Many schools across Flintshire are taking part in Odd Socks Day today to start Anti-Bullying Week 2026, Flintshire County Council has said. stories.title: North Wales Police launch Operation Sceptre week in Flintshire North
stories.summary: Police are collecting unwanted knives at pop-up stops in Holywell, Bagillt, Flint and Deeside today as part of a national week of action on knife crime. stories.title: New Ofcom rules require more sites to detect and remove child sexual abuse material
stories.summary: Websites and apps will have to ban users who share child sexual abuse images and do more to find and remove them, under new rules set out today by Ofcom. stories.title: Alun School in Mold closed today after central heating fault
stories.summary: Alun School in Mold is closed today because of a fault with its central heating system. In a post on its Facebook page, the school said: Please do not travel to school today. stories.title: Overnight lane closures on A494 eastbound at St David’s interchange start tonight
stories.summary: Part of the A494 eastbound at the St David’s Park interchange will close overnight from tonight while a safety barrier is upgraded.
